content.text:
The "Add to cart" buttons on the products page were unreadable. `.btn-secondary` in `site/css/components.css` had its text color set to `var(--color-surface)`, which is also its background color, so the text was invisible. I changed the text color to `var(--color-ink)`.

The visual tests for home, pricing and orders were also failing, because they use the same button style. All 12 visual tests now pass. I didn't run the functional tests, and I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
